create_FunctionEnvironment: create a FunctionEnvironment instance with params to generate symbolic regression training data and manage equation encoding
generate_symbolic_regression_samples: generate symbolic regression expression samples with configurable input dimensions, unary ops, and binary ops using gen_expr
encode_decode_equations: encode equation trees to token IDs or decode token IDs back to infix notation using equation_encoder
create_train_iterator: create a DataLoader for training with configurable batch size, queue strategy, and collate function for symbolic regression tasks
create_test_iterator: create a DataLoader for validation or test evaluation with specified batch size and input length modulo
